shorts.hook: This fish catches seabirds that are still flying.
shorts.title: Giant Trevally Leap Out of the Sea to Catch Flying Birds
shorts.outro: The next predator eats sharks whole. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: At one Seychelles island, giant trevally launch themselves out of the lagoon and snatch seabirds in mid-air.

shorts.hook: The goliath grouper outweighs a baby grand piano, and it eats sharks.
shorts.title: A Goliath Grouper Swallowed a Whole Shark in One Bite
shorts.outro: What happens next is even worse. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: In 2014 off Florida, a goliath grouper rose from below and swallowed a hooked blacktip shark in a single gulp.

shorts.title: Orcas Hunt Great Whites but Have No Record of Killing Us
shorts.outro: Then the cap goes missing. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: The ocean's top predator kills great whites and hunts blue whales, yet has no record of killing a person in the wild.
